alerts.title: Highland WMA Suspension Foot Bridge Closed
alerts.description: Effective immediately, and until further notice, the suspension foot bridge over the Bullpasture River on the Highland WMA is closed. A recent inspection of the bridge revealed significant degradation of major structural components deeming it unsafe for use.

alerts.title: Sunfish Pond Low Water Notice
alerts.description: Due to a leak in the stand pipe for the Sunfish pond the water levels will remain low and fluctuate. Anglers are prohibited from fishing in the immediate area of the stand pipe until further notice. Fishing can still be done from the parking area at the upper part of the lake but caution should be used due to the mud and sediment. Please also consider the Bullhead Pond or Bass Pond as alternatives when fishing at this area.

alerts.title: Ragged Island WMA Habitat Restoration & Coastal Resilience Project and Related Closures
alerts.description: In 2025, the Virginia Department of Wildlife Resources began a transformational habitat restoration and coastal resilience project at Ragged Island Wildlife Management Area (WMA). As part of the final phase of this project, critical vegetation will be planted on the dunes and near the James River shoreline. To protect the developing vegetation and ensure root establishment, the Department is restricting access to the area by closing the northern WMA parking lot on U.S. Route 17. alerts.title: Lake Thompson Trout Stocking
alerts.description: Due to inconsistent water levels, we have discontinued trout stocking at Lake Thompson indefinitely.
